question: I need more fast mana and I'm looking for anything that produces those artifact tokens you sacrifice for mana. This is for Commander.
My playgroup runs a lot of graveyard hate and I keep losing my whole yard. I want something that puts my discard pile back into my deck. Budget is a concern.
I'm building a deck that treats life as a resource. I want abilities where you spend life to turn them on, not ones that just drain you as an effect. Any colour works.

I'm building an artifact deck that wants to eat its own permanents for value. I need the sacrifice to be part of paying for the ability, not something the ability does to my opponents. Colour doesn't matter much.
I want creatures that aren't card disadvantage when they trade in combat. Something that cantrips on the way out. This is for Commander.
I'm on a lands-matter build with a lot of extra land drops. I want payoffs that put bodies down every time a land shows up. Budget doesn't matter.
I need to fill my yard while digging for combo pieces. One spell that draws and then makes me pitch is right, rather than two separate effects. This is for Commander.

I want the classic drain: opponents lose life and I gain the same amount off one trigger. Two separate abilities that happen to do both things isn't the same thing. This is for a black devotion build.
I want fliers that still pay me off after they eat removal. The death trigger matters more than the size. Ideally in white.

I want a single card that's a self-contained aristocrats engine - it makes the bodies and it can sacrifice them without needing another card. One card doing both halves, not two cards. This is for Commander.

I'm building a group-slug deck and I'd like anything that hits every opponent at once with damage. It needs to hit all of them, not just one - targeted burn doesn't help me here. Budget isn't a concern.
My deck folds to a wide board. I want a reset that puts every creature back in hand instead of killing them, since I'd rather not give my opponents graveyard value. This is for Commander.
I want to go wide without needing fodder to feed in. Making bodies shouldn't cost me other bodies. This is for Commander.
My opponents keep resolving hexproof and ward threats I can't point anything at. I need answers that kill without choosing a target. Budget is a concern.
I want basic ramp in my green deck. A sorcery that digs a land out is what I'm after. This is for Commander.
I want to make blockers during my opponent's attack instead of telegraphing them on my own turn. Sorceries are too slow. Ideally in white.
I want a blocker nobody wants to attack into that also pulls my life total back up. Both abilities on one body. Budget matters.
My deck runs out of gas around turn six. I'm looking for something that keeps drawing me extra cards every turn on its own, not a one-shot that refills once and then does nothing. Budget matters.
I'm on an aristocrats build and I need a way to throw my own creatures away at will, ideally repeatable and free. This is for Commander.
I want to cheat fatties into play after pitching them early. Getting them onto the board matters, not back to my hand. Budget is a concern.
I need consistency finding my combo piece. I want it in hand so I can cast it on my own terms rather than dumped straight onto the board. This is for Commander.
I'd rather not tap out on my own turn - I want to kill a creature during someone else's turn, ideally at the end of their turn. Sorceries don't work for this. Any colour is fine.
I like holding up mana and deploying threats on the end step. A creature I can only cast in my own main phase doesn't do that. Ideally in blue.
I run out of gas by turn six and need one spell that refills my hand in a single go, not one that trickles cards over time. Budget doesn't matter.
I'm on a self-mill build and I want a threat whose size scales with how much I've dumped. It should read off my own pile. This is for Commander.
I want cards that exile. There's a lot of graveyard recursion in my playgroup so exiling comes up a lot. What's out there?
I need removal for my deck but I'm not sure what counts as good these days. My playgroup runs a lot of different threats. Budget is a concern.
I'm building around my creatures dying. Anything that interacts with that is interesting to me. This is for Commander.
I like copying things, it's my favourite thing to do in Magic. What's out there? Budget doesn't matter.
I'm on a build with a lot of cheap burn and cantrips, and I want a creature that turns each of those into a body. Ideally in red.
I want to use my tap abilities more than once per turn cycle. Untapping on everybody's turn is the effect. This is for Commander.
I want extra card access without actually drawing. Casting straight off the top is the effect I'm after. Budget is a concern.
I'm new to Commander and I have about thirty dollars. Which commander should I build? I like green.
I'm putting a Modern deck together and want to avoid anything illegal. Which cards can't I play? Budget matters.
I want to untap my permanents during my opponent's upkeep so I can respond with them. Does that exist? This is for Commander.
I'm looking for sorceries that have flash so I can cast them on my opponent's turn. Does that exist, and if so which ones are worth playing?
I'm on a group hug build where the whole table benefits. I want extra draw for everyone, not just me. Budget doesn't matter.
I'm building a blink deck so basically every creature needs to do something when it lands. This is for Commander.
I just need clean single-target creature kill. Something I can point at the scariest thing on board. Ideally in black.
I keep dying to burn and I'd like something that stops damage pointed at me specifically, not at my creatures. Repeatable would be ideal but I'll take one-shots. Ideally in white.
